name: image-viewer-multios
description: MyImageViewer — multi-platform image viewer and editor with dark/light themes and Korean/English support
author: SHKWON

scripts.build:win: node scripts/stamp-version.js && node scripts/stage-runtime.js && tauri build --bundles nsis && node scripts/copy-installer.js nsis
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/stamp-version.js && node scripts/stage-runtime.js && tauri build --bundles dmg && node scripts/copy-installer.js dmg
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/stamp-version.js && node scripts/stage-runtime.js && tauri build --bundles deb && node scripts/copy-installer.js deb
